title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Desk Reference Card — Late Payment Charge on a Closed Commercial Account Statement
content:
On a pay-in-full account, a late payment charge is owed for the latest closed statement when that statement shows more days past due than the tier's late charge grace days and no late payment charge carries its statement period yet; the charge is assessed against that statement line and carries that statement's period, and a statement whose period already carries a late payment charge, or that shows no more days past due than the grace days, is charged nothing.

## Scope

This card covers the Ridgeline Commercial Account tiers of Ridgeline Pro Credit — Net 30, Net 30 Select, Net 45 and Net 60 Enterprise — which are pay-in-full. The charge is the statement late payment charge for the account's latest closed statement, and it is booked as one late payment charge line referencing that statement.

| Latest closed statement | Late payment charge already carrying its period | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Days past due above the tier's grace days | None | A late payment charge is owed for it |
| Days past due above the tier's grace days | One already | Nothing is charged |
| Days past due at or below the tier's grace days | Any | Nothing is charged |

## Booking the charge

The charge is booked by the agent with the task tool `assess_late_payment_charge_c9e93ff5`. It is a hidden tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Capability.** One call books one late payment charge line for one closed statement of a Ridgeline Pro Credit commercial account. The line references the statement it is charged for and carries that statement's period, is dated today, and raises the account's current balance by the charge.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `trade_account_id` | The reference number of the Ridgeline Pro Credit account being charged, as returned by the Pro Credit account lookup | Identifier |
| `statement_period` | The billing period of the statement the charge is for | YYYY-MM, exactly as it appears on that statement line |
| `original_transaction_id` | The reference number of the statement line the charge is for, as returned by the Pro Credit activity lookup | Identifier |
| `charge_amount` | The late payment charge | USD, a positive number rounded to 2 decimal places; booked exactly as given |

### Return

On success the tool returns `status` "charged", `trade_transaction_id` (the reference number of the new charge line), `statement_period` (YYYY-MM), `charge_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `transaction_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD) and `current_balance` (the account balance after the charge, USD, 2 decimal places). The tool's contract defines no other outcome.
